text_block_list.text:
On our way back, we run into the white
cat again.
For some reason, he keeps his
distance from us
today.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
He ran off. Guess I shouldn't be too
surprised.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
A while ago, I tried to take Frosty in... I
blew it,
though.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Y'know how I said he's been getting
weaker?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I thought it'd be a good idea for Frosty
to
become a house cat. I even looked for
someone
to take care of him.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hey, Frosty. It's okay now.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to live out on the streets

anymore. C'mere...

text_block_list.name: White Cat
text_block_list.text: Mraaaooww!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I never saw him so angry before. I was so

confused.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
But then I started wondering why he'd
been a
stray all this time.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I mean, why would a cat as clever and
friendly as
Frosty choose the streets?
Why wouldn't he just
settle down in
someone's home?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Looking back, I think the reason he was
able to
make it out there is because he
held onto his
pride.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I tried to force him to change his
lifestyle, saying
he'd be happier if he
had a home.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
But really, I'm the one who can't handle
the
situation.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to try talking to him one last
time.
'Cause I really do want an easy life
for him.

"But I'll let Frosty choose for himself,"
she says
softly to herself.

The big day comes and Seiun Sky waits
for Frosty
along his patrol route.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Frosty. I wanted to apologize
about the
other day. I was being selfish.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
The world of stray cats is cruel, but
you've done
so well making a life for
yourself out here.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
But y'know... I think you've struggled for
long
enough.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I can't help it. I want you to be happy,
Frosty—to
be safe... because I'm your
friend.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But that's just how I feel. What you do next, well, it's up to you.

text_block_list.name: White Cat
text_block_list.text: ...Meow.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Frosty!

Frosty slowly approaches Sky, who lifts
him gently
and hugs him tight.

And so, the two of them head off to
Frosty's new
home.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'm glad things ended happily... but oh, how I'll miss my Beatrix! Sniffle...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You're still using that name? You know
Frosty's a
male cat, right?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Sei, are you really okay with this? It must
hurt to
say adios to an amigo...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well... I guess I'd be lying if I said I won't
miss him.
Nya-ha-ha!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well... I guess I'd be lying if I said I won't
miss him.
Nya-ha-ha!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. I'm thinking I'll go check on him
every
now and then.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh right, his name won't be Frosty
anymore. He's
on cat life number two
now, and that means
getting a new
name.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Being served food without having to ask
for it,
staying warm and snug all day...
Retirement must
be real nice.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I know, geez. I've still got plenty of pep
in my
step. I've learned a thing or two
from Frosty!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
What a relief, though. I was really
worried
whether or not I was being too
forceful. I mean, I
can't really decide
what's best for him on my own,
right?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
But all my plotting paid off in the end.
We really
couldn't have asked for a
happier ending!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, Frosty went and retired without too much fuss, but there's still plenty of gas in this tank.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Okey dokey, I made it through that
painful
goodbye, so now it's time to get
back on track!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oho, what's this? Why, you're just about
the
biggest cat I've ever seen.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Brace yourself—you're in for a floofing!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Take this! And this! How's that? Now say
"uncle"!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
There, there... You don't have to try and
take
Frosty's place, you know. I'll be
fine.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I like you best when you're just being
yourself,
Trainer... Nya-ha-ha! ♪
